name: supervisor_subagent
description: Sub-agent half of the supervisor-inside-agent_call combination test. Structurally identical to iterative_writer_agent.json's editor/draft loop, but with output_step set so it can actually be called via agent_call - iterative_writer_agent.json never needed that since nothing calls it as a sub-agent. Requires GROQ_API_KEY on the worker.

steps.prompt_template:
You are editing a short paragraph answering a question, judging the latest draft below.

Question: {{user_input}}

Latest draft:
{{draft.output}}

If the draft answers the question clearly and concisely, respond with exactly: done
Otherwise, respond with exactly: draft

Respond with only one of those two words, nothing else.
